info.title: CF Meet Meeting Service / Account — admin bridge operator reads and commands
info.description: Operator reads the Meeting Service (Account authority and conferences) exposes to cfmeet.admin-bridge only (ADR 0068, design §6.1–6.2): account search and detail, sessions, devices, MFA status and security history (account.administer), meeting spaces, conferences, live conferences, participants and the conference audit (meeting.administer). Every request also needs X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>. Served only while ADMIN_OPERATOR_API_ENABLED=true. Minimal by construction: ids, states, counts and times; never a password hash, token, session label, device key, MFA secret or recovery code, IP address, location, message content or media. 1.1.0 (A4-A7): R3 / R4 COMMANDS (POST, Idempotency-Key required, expectedVersion where the subject is versioned, X-CF-Approver / X-CF-Approval-Ref / X-CF-Intent-Digest required) recorded in meeting_admin_operations in the same transaction and answered {status, version, resource}; the settlement read GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}; further reads (duplicates, test accounts, conference health, recordings, transcripts, webinars and registrations, chat migration, email deliveries, CRITICAL lane). Account reads answer `version` (users.account_version).

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer EdDSA service token from packages/service-auth; audience cfmeet.meeting-service; issuer must be cfmeet.admin-bridge holding the stated permission in the receiver's trust bundle.

Operator.name: X-CF-Operator
Operator.description: The HQ staff member the admin bridge reads for (ADR 0068). Accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge; operator attribution from any other caller is refused on every internal route of the service.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: HQ's operation id (= the bridge body's operation_id and the readback key). A repeated key for the same command and subject answers the current resource without applying again; for anything else 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Approver.name: X-CF-Approver
Approver.description: The second person of the R3 / R4 approval (a different hq: staff member).

OperatorUserId.name: x-cf-operator-user-id
OperatorUserId.description: The staff member's linked CF Meet account, if any: an account command on that account is refused (422 SELF_ACTION_REFUSED).
